# auth.me — GET /auth/me

Current user

Returns the user the bearer token belongs to.

## Call
```ts
const res = await user.auth.me()
res.assert(200)
```

## Responses
```ts
200: UserDto
401: ErrorDto // Missing or invalid bearer token.
```

## Types
```ts
type UserDto = {
  /** User id. */

  /** Avatar URL. `null` until the user uploads an avatar. */

type ErrorDto = {
```
